items.title: Brock Purdy: Keeps rolling in wild Week 10 win
items.text:
Purdy completed 22 of 28 passes for 389 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and added two carries for 21 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Breakout performance in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Tyson caught 11 of 13 targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.

items.title: Travis Etienne: Makes little impact in return
items.text:
Etienne carried the ball eight times for 14 yards and caught three of five targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.

items.title: George Pickens: Career-high totals in return
items.text:
Pickens brought in 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Weak showing in loss to Carolina
items.text:
Shough completed 25 of 35 targets for 187 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added 25 rushing yards on six carries and was charged with a lost fumble.
